newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher volume.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed down 0.07 percent in Monday in volume boosted by over-the-counter business, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 481.36 points, down from 481.72 on Friday.
Total volume was 2.94 million dinars against 1.72 million dinars over the previous session.
Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 2.3 million dinars.
Airline Tunis Air was up 0.14 dinar to 24 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie rose 0.16 dinar to 32.2.
Retail stores Monoprix fell 1.04 dinar to 33.78 dinars. Real estate firm Societe Immobiliere et de Participation slid 0.76 dinar to 22.3 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was down 0.3 dinar to 16 dinars. Tuninvest -SICAF fund declined 0.21 dinar to 11.99. UIB bank eased 0.21 dinar to 11.9 dinars.
Trade was active on Banque Nationale Agricole with 11,755 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 27.38 dinars.
